title: Optimal Trudinger-Moser inequalities on complete noncompact Riemannian manifolds: Revisit of the argument from the local inequalities to global ones
summary: The main purpose of this short note, on the one hand, to is rigorize some part of the proof of Theorem 1.3 in [11] in a simple way, and on the other hand, to give an alternative argument from local inequalities to global ones.
